Body.Content:
What and Why:

We are expanding enterprise policy support for the Copilot desktop app's built-in browser on Windows and Mac. This update adds admin controls across security, privacy, content access, authentication/network behavior, and download/permission management so organizations can align in-app browsing with their existing browser governance standards.

Rollout Schedule:

General Availability (Worldwide): Available now.

Impact on Your Organization:

This feature gives organizations stronger administrative control over the Copilot desktop app's built-in browser on Windows and Mac. Customers can apply enterprise policies for security, privacy, authentication, network behavior, and site/content access so in-app browsing aligns with existing compliance and governance standards. For end users, this improves consistency with corporate browser rules; some browsing capabilities may be restricted or prompted based on admin policy configuration.

Action Required/Recommendations:

These additional policies only apply if the built-in browser is enabled via the "BrowsingEnabled" policy, which is off by default. Admins should review current browser governance and apply the new Copilot in-app browsing policies to match existing security/compliance standards, then validate critical sites/auth flows with a pilot group and communicate any user-facing behavior changes.

Compliance considerations:

No compliance considerations identified. Review as appropriate for your organization.

Details.Value: Enterprise policies now control Copilot desktop app's built-in browser on Windows and Mac, covering security, privacy, content access, authentication, and permissions. Title: Adding in app browsing control policies
